scientific_integrity: Complete analytic finite-dimensional proof with independent algebraic and numerical consistency checks. The source date is the earliest verified public posting of the motivating graph-energy paper, not a date of the present finding.
scientific_limitations: Finite complete graphs, equal positive edge weights, unit vertex mass; sharp perturbation factor not claimed for general graphs or other activations. Independent scientific audit absent; historical exact equivalent cannot be ruled out.
title: Sharp two-point stability of positive-part truncation in complete-graph Sobolev norms
